articles.title: Amazon AI exec predicts first 'commercially useful' quantum computers in 5-7 years
articles.description: Quantum computing is becoming an increasingly competitive field, with tech giants including Microsoft, Google and IBM developing the technology.

articles.title: AI will create more jobs for humans, not replace them, Amazon founder Bezos says
articles.description: The Amazon founder, who now has robotics and space travel companies, thinks AI will create a labour shortage.

articles.title: Target, Walmart and Amazon among brands losing LGBTQ+ consumer spending, new survey says
articles.description: LGBTQ+ consumers are shifting spending toward companies they view as supporting DEI and away from those seen as retreating, HRC survey finds.
